description: Cross-SDK vectors for verifyHttpSpendRequest (HTTP mandate presentation + spend enforcement). Generated by packages/aroha-credentials/scripts/gen-http-spend-vectors.ts; do not edit by hand. Each case starts with an empty ledger and nonce store. Request steps are verified with the top-level audience, url, body and now (unless the step gives its own now: the one clock for presentation, nonce and mandate expiry), method POST unless the step says otherwise, isRevoked null, and expectedRoot the human unless the step has an expectedRoot member (null = supplied but empty, which must refuse with ROOT_NOT_PINNED). A step {release: i} releases the charge of step i. expectedTotals gives each mandate's running total (by mandates[name]; keyed in the ledger by grantor#mandateId); mandates not listed have a total of 0. amountFloat carries amounts JSON cannot (NaN, Infinity, -Infinity).

cases.name: within-limit
cases.description: One spend inside the limit is charged.

cases.name: over-limit-single
cases.description: One spend above the limit is refused before the ledger is touched.

cases.name: over-running-total
cases.description: The running total, not each spend, is held to the limit: $500.01 cannot pass a $500 mandate in parts.

cases.name: sibling-exceeds-parent
cases.description: Two carts under one $500 intent each claim $400; together they cannot spend more than the intent's $500.

cases.name: leaf-exhausted-rolls-back-parent
cases.description: The second $60 fits the intent but not the $100 cart; the intent's charge is undone.

cases.name: currency-mismatch
cases.description: Spend currency defaults to USD and must equal every link's currency (default USD).

cases.name: merchant
cases.description: allowedMerchants: a missing merchant refuses (fail closed); a merchant off the list refuses.

cases.name: human-approval
cases.description: Above requireHumanApprovalAboveUsd the server must assert humanApproved: true; at the threshold it need not.

cases.name: session-limit
cases.description: The running-total limit is min(spendLimitUsd, sessionLimitUsd).

cases.name: invalid-amounts
cases.description: Invalid amounts refuse with 400 before the presentation is checked, so the same header still works with a valid amount.

cases.name: task-mandate
cases.description: A task mandate presented to a spending endpoint is refused.

cases.name: release-after-failed-side-effect
cases.description: release() returns the charge to every link.

cases.name: presentation-and-chain-failures
cases.description: Refusals from the presentation (401) and the chain (403) keep their codes and charge nothing.

cases.name: root-not-pinned
cases.description: expectedRoot supplied but null (a customer with no enrolled DID) refuses with ROOT_NOT_PINNED 403 without consuming the nonce: the same header then succeeds with the root pinned.

cases.name: mandate-expiry-on-injected-clock
cases.description: The step's now (when given) is the one clock for the presentation, the nonce and the mandate: a fresh presentation of a mandate that expired before that clock is refused.
